description: Source code for disk access management in Zephyr OS, including functions for registering, unregistering, initializing, and performing operations on disk devices.

methods.name: disk_access_get_di
methods.description: Retrieves disk information structure by disk name.

methods.name: disk_access_init
methods.description: Initializes disk device by calling its init operation.

methods.name: disk_access_status
methods.description: Checks the status of the disk device.

methods.name: disk_access_read
methods.description: Reads data from the disk device.

methods.name: disk_access_write
methods.description: Writes data to the disk device.

methods.name: disk_access_ioctl
methods.description: Performs control operations on the disk device.
